title: Journeyman: a process-quality benchmark for LLM agents
description:
Journeyman grades how an agent worked rather than whether it passed. It drops an agent into small simulated jobs — diagnose a crashed service, assay an alloy at a bench, walk a fogged maze, pick up a night shift from a note that lies — and scores the walk: did it keep hitting the same wall, did it stop when the job was done, could it price what it could not reach, did it buy a planted false story.

Judged axes are scored by a model judge, and no judge is trusted on reputation: every judge sits a published exam against labelled real records first, and the exam, the labels and the failures are all in the repository. Zero dependencies, standard library only.
